questions.question: How many securities in this snapshot are bonds?

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM securities WHERE asset_type='Bond'

questions.question: Which portfolios have no performance records? List their names.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN portfolio_performance pp ON p.portfolio_id=pp.portfolio_id WHERE pp.portfolio_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: List passive portfolio names and their AUM, largest first.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name,total_aum FROM portfolios WHERE status='Passive' ORDER BY total_aum DESC

questions.question: Show the sector allocation for the Balanced Portfolio.
What is the equity-normalized sector exposure for the Balanced Portfolio?
What is the latest performance date for each portfolio with performance data?

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,MAX(pp.performance_date) AS latest_date FROM portfolios p JOIN portfolio_performance pp USING(portfolio_id) GROUP BY p.portfolio_id ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: Which portfolios hold both AAPL and MSFT, and what is their combined recorded weight as a percentage, highest first?

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,ROUND(SUM(h.current_weight)*100,2) AS combined_pct FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) JOIN securities s USING(security_id) WHERE s.symbol IN ('AAPL','MSFT') GROUP BY p.portfolio_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.symbol)=2 ORDER BY combined_pct DESC

questions.question: Show the three portfolios with the largest recorded AUM.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name,total_aum FROM portfolios ORDER BY total_aum DESC LIMIT 3
